baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated خ ل ق at words 10, 22, and 24, the formed/unformed contrast, and لِنُبَيِّنَ at word 25.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive materials are measured toward form, while configured and unconfigured outcomes remain visible inside the account; variation in formation is itself part of the disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The image of measuring and proportioning makes the material sequence a governed process rather than a loose inventory.
Complete and balanced form supplies the positive pole against which the unconfigured is named.
Disclosure by speech or sign assigns the sequence an evidentiary function: its distinctions are meant to make a meaning clear.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a chronological list of embryonic substances.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a measured disclosure in which both achieved form and non-achieved form expose governance over possible outcomes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نُقِرُّ in the womb until an appointed term, followed by نُخْرِجُكُمْ, maturity, taking in death, and return to low age.
baseline_models.mechanism: Life advances through regulated intervals of fixation and release: attachment and womb-settlement hold a developing being, a term limits that holding, emergence releases it, and later taking or reversal closes or unwinds acquired capacity.

activation_trace.role: Fixity and settlement make the womb an active holding interval rather than a passive location.
The female womb supplies the bounded site in which selected life is retained.
A fixed temporal limit turns retention into a scheduled interval with an endpoint.
Passage to the outside supplies the release that follows womb-settlement.
Taking the soul makes death another governed transfer rather than an accidental interruption.
Return to a prior condition makes senescence a reversal of capacities acquired across the sequence.

changed_reading.before: The ayah narrates uninterrupted growth from conception to old age.
changed_reading.after: The biography is a chain of bounded holdings, authorized exits, and reversals; resurrection belongs to the same grammar of retained and released life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Doubt concerning البعث is answered by human formation and by the inert earth moving, swelling, and sprouting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah repeats one operation at bodily and terrestrial scales: what is still, hidden, or apparently lifeless is stirred, enlarged through nurture, and made manifest in differentiated life.

activation_trace.role: Stirring something stationary from its resting state supplies the operation that the two demonstrations model.
Dried, lifeless stillness gives the terrestrial starting state a death-like latency.
Earth and vegetation moving with life makes resurrection perceptible as activation, not merely replacement.
Nourishment and growth connect the earth's swelling to the preceding account of human development.
The branch that applies growth and nurture to a human lets plant emergence and human maturation illuminate one another.

changed_reading.before: Human gestation and revived land are two separate examples supporting resurrection.
changed_reading.after: They are two scales of one latent-to-manifest mechanism: stirring, nurture, enlargement, emergence, and differentiation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening quake reverses the focus ayah's reproductive motion: instead of water-driven movement issuing in growth, violent movement breaks nursing attention and makes every bearer put down her burden. Motion therefore marks a threshold whose outcome can be nurture and manifestation or catastrophic unloading.

activation_trace.role: Life-bearing movement of earth supplies the productive side of the kinetic contrast.
Womb-settlement supplies the retained condition that catastrophic unloading can reverse.
Convulsive shaking supplies a destructive counterpart to the focus earth's life-bearing movement.
Suckling interrupted by shock shows nurture severed at the moment of upheaval.
Putting down a pregnancy supplies forced release from gestational holding.
The inwardly carried fruit makes explicit what the quake compels the bearer to relinquish.

structural_cues: 22:1-2 places convulsive shaking, abandoned nursing, and unloaded pregnancy immediately before the focus.
22:5 places womb retention and the earth's water-driven movement inside one proof of resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite reproductive effects of movement; I infer that kinetic release is the shared arrow and that governance determines its valence. A live alternative is that the opening catastrophe and the rain scene are only contrasting images, not one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The earth's movement is a uniformly gentle image of revival.
changed_reading.after: Against the opening quake, movement becomes an ambivalent threshold: it may disclose retained life through growth or terminate retention through violent unloading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus womb, consecrated animals, and the sky all occupy governed intervals: something is held in place, its utility or stability continues to a limit, and release or arrival occurs only at an appointed term, destination, or permission.

activation_trace.role: Settlement supplies the focus instance of controlled containment.
Exit supplies the transition that follows completed containment.
The repeated fixed term extends the focus's temporal boundary into the ritual handling of living animals.
Arrival or settlement at a destination gives the appointed interval a directed endpoint.
Holding and restraining the sky scales the focus's retention mechanism up to cosmic suspension.
Falling and coming to rest names the release that is presently prevented.
Permission makes release contingent rather than autonomous.

structural_cues: 22:33 repeats 'until an appointed term' and then names the animals' destination.
22:65 describes the sky as held from falling except by permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated term, destination, holding, falling, and permission language; I infer one containment-release grammar spanning womb, ritual life, and sky. The materially live alternative is that these are only formal parallels and should not make the three referents interchangeable.

changed_reading.before: Womb retention is a local biological detail before birth.
changed_reading.after: Womb retention is one instance of a surah-wide rule of authorized suspension: life, matter, and even the sky remain held until a designated release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late fly parable separates aggregation from creation and recovery: gathering all agents does not generate even a fly, and they cannot extract what it takes. Read back into the focus, successive materials do not explain themselves by accumulation; creative agency both gives form and can bring hidden life out.

activation_trace.role: Origination and bringing into existence anchors the focus sequence in agency rather than material self-sufficiency.
Bringing something out of concealment links creation to recoverable manifestation.
The explicit inability to originate a fly supplies the contrastive test of creative agency.
Joining dispersed parts into a collection is shown to remain insufficient for creation.
Failure to extract something from another's grasp adds failed recovery to failed origination.
Lack of strength diagnoses both the seeker and sought as incapable of the focus ayah's transformations.

structural_cues: 22:73 addresses the same الناس as 22:5 and contrasts creating a fly with merely gathering together.
The parable couples failure to create with failure to recover what has been taken.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit creation-versus-assembly contrast and a failed extraction; I apply that contrast backward to the focus's material stages and forward to emergence. An alternative is that the parable rebukes rival worship only and does not analyze embryonic causality.

changed_reading.before: The ordered substances could be read as an adequate material account of how a human comes together.
changed_reading.after: The sequence displays material dependence but denies that aggregation is creative sufficiency; formation and re-emergence require an agency able to originate and extract.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible ruined settlements and an idle well do not teach automatically; travel across the earth must become heart-level binding of evidence, while eyes may remain intact and the heart blind. The focus's 'you see the earth' therefore initiates reasoning rather than completing proof by sight alone.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye and insight opens the focus's terrestrial sign to both perception and understanding.
Making meaning clear establishes that perceived stages require interpretation.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower anchors the ayah's concern with gained and lost cognition.
Emptiness turns a ruined settlement into a visible social analogue of the focus's inert earth.
An unused well supplies available but suspended life-support whose visibility alone does not restore a community.
Movement through the earth converts distant traces into encountered evidence.
The mind's restraining and binding function supplies the missing operation between seeing a sign and accepting its force.
Blindness of heart shows why intact eyesight can fail to activate the focus's visible analogy.

structural_cues: 22:45 presents conspicuous ruins and an abandoned well; 22:46 immediately asks why travel through the earth has not produced reasoning hearts.
22:5 joins 'so that We make clear to you,' loss of knowledge after knowledge, and 'you see the earth.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible ruins, travel, reasoning hearts, and heart-blindness; I infer that the focus's visual demonstration needs cognitive binding. A live alternative is that 22:46 addresses historical judgment specifically and only secondarily governs the natural sign in 22:5.

changed_reading.before: Watching dead-looking earth revive is self-sufficient visual proof.
changed_reading.after: The visible revival is pedagogical evidence that must be bound into knowledge; the ayah also warns, through cognitive decline, how fragile the human capacity to perform that binding is.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual insertion of night and day and the explicit life-death-life sequence make the focus's repeated 'then' more than linear ascent. Created states can pass into their opposites and be brought back again under the same agency.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior state gives the focus biography an internal reversal before the context expands the pattern.
Stirring the still supplies the transition by which a quiescent phase can become active again.
Each temporal state entering the other supplies a reversible alternation rather than a one-way replacement.
Living being on both sides of death makes reanimation explicit at the human scale.
Loss of life forms the intervening phase rather than the terminal limit of the sequence.

structural_cues: 22:61 repeats reciprocal insertion: night into day and day into night.
22:66 repeats the focus's sequencing particle around life, death, and renewed life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal temporal transition and life-death-life; I infer a general reversible phase grammar for the focus's stages. An alternative is that night/day demonstrates power by analogy without implying that every developmental stage is reversible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah presents one forward biography ending in death or decline, followed by a separate plant comparison.
changed_reading.after: The biography participates in controlled phase alternation: acquired states can be reversed, life can pass through death, and stillness can be stirred again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a revelatory cast-remove-firm sequence onto embryonic formed/unformed material. It remains anchored in the focus's formed/unformed contrast, selective womb-settlement, and clarifying purpose; downstream prose should present it only as a formal process analogy, not as a lexical gloss or biological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ, نُقِرُّ ... مَا نَشَاءُ, and لِنُبَيِّنَ.

activation_trace.role: Completed form supplies the stabilized outcome in the exploratory process analogy.
Negation and otherness preserve a non-formed alternative rather than collapsing all material into one outcome.
Selective settlement supplies the retention stage after divergent outcomes have been named.
Casting material into a process supplies the exploratory input stage.
Removal followed by replacement supplies a rejected or displaced outcome.
Making firm and secure supplies the stabilized counterpart to removal.

changed_reading.before: Formed and unformed are static labels inside a developmental list.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they expose a filtering architecture: introduced possibilities diverge, some are displaced, some are stabilized and retained, and the divergence itself clarifies agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Calling the eschatological day barren is a sharp reproductive reversal after a focus saturated with womb, child, growth, and proliferating kinds. The contrast is securely anchored but should be rendered as a terminal counter-image, not as a claim that the day is literally a womb or that ordinary fertility is condemned.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The womb and child sequence, followed by the earth sprouting every delightful kind.

activation_trace.role: The female womb supplies the focus's primary site of generative continuity.
Vegetation emerging from earth extends generation beyond the womb.
Kinds and varieties make the revived earth proliferative rather than merely alive.
Fresh beauty marks the attractive fullness of the focus's generative endpoint.
Infertility of womb and offspring supplies the terminal counter-image to the focus's proliferating life.

changed_reading.before: The womb-to-child and rain-to-growth sequences suggest indefinitely recurring generation.
changed_reading.after: The later barren day places a terminal boundary around ordinary reproductive recurrence: resurrection opens a final order rather than another turn of the same fertility cycle.

strongest_changes: The opening quake turns movement from a uniformly benign revival image into an ambivalent release that can either manifest or unload retained life.
Repeated term, destination, holding, falling, and permission language scales womb retention into a surah-wide mechanism of authorized containment and release.
The fly parable distinguishes creation from assembly and recovery, preventing the embryonic materials from becoming a self-sufficient causal account.
Ruins and heart-blindness revise 'you see the earth' into evidence that requires cognitive binding rather than automatic assent.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not merely repeat resurrection claims; it supplied reversals and cross-scale controls that changed how gestation, earth revival, perception, and emergence function inside 22:5.
remaining_uncertainties: The quake/rain kinetic pairing is strong but may remain a designed contrast rather than a single causal mechanism.
The ritual and cosmic containment parallels should not erase the distinct material roles of womb, animal, and sky.
The cast-remove-firm outlier is useful only as a contained process analogy.
The barren-day contrast supports terminality, but the precise scope of that terminality remains exploratory.
